record.question: B mortgages a one storey house to A. The mortgage is in form of usufructuary mortgage. During the duration of mortgage, A without the permission of B, constructs two more floors, and rented them out. At the time of redemption of the property which of the following statement will apply?
options: A is entitled to set out the rent received on the two floors constructed by him, against the amount spent for construction
A is entitled to recover the cost of additional construction from B
A in entitled to recover the cost of additional construction from B, or in case of default to destroy the construction done by him
